tests.message: Verdict not allowed for this test: 'warning' (allowed: passed, failed)

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body is dense but nearly all content is domain-specific: check-ids, AWS API names, routing rules, severity definitions, and specific gotchas. It does not waste space explaining generic concepts the agent already knows (e.g., what Bedrock or SageMaker are).
tests.evidence: Content focuses on 'LLM-EVAL-012', 'stopReason', 'bedrock:GetModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration' etc. rather than general explanations.

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.message: Verdict not allowed for this test: 'warning' (allowed: passed, failed)

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: Every file in references/ is linked via markdown link syntax in the body.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link is accompanied by explicit load conditions throughout the body and in the Appendix.
tests.evidence: "[checks-evaluation.md](references/checks-evaluation.md) — load before assigning any check-id or severity" and "[metrics-and-logs.md](references/metrics-and-logs.md) — load before any log query or metric read"

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference paths use relative paths of the form references/filename.md with no absolute paths or traversals.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile operations (read-only guardrails, finish-reason query mechanics, delegation payload contract) are given exact prescriptive instructions, while flexible areas (synthesis, review prioritization) allow judgment with rationale given.
tests.evidence: "Read-only. Never call a mutating API — in particular CreateEvaluationJob, StopEvaluationJob..." contrasts with "For an incident, lead with the root cause... and the highest-impact action"

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: Where multiple paths/tools exist, a default route is designated and the skill names which to use first, with alternates as fallback, rather than listing all as equal.
tests.evidence: "Decide which service ran the job first (Step 1)" and clear primary path designations like "Bedrock CreateEvaluationJob path" vs alternate paths.

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable investigation procedure (Steps 1-5) applicable to any evaluation incident or review, not a one-off task declaration.
tests.evidence: "Step 1: Understand the question, pick the path and confirm regional support" through "Step 5: Synthesize" generalizes across many scenarios.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill has an extensive 'Common wrong answers' section plus inline gotcha-like guardrails addressing non-obvious pitfalls specific to this domain.
tests.evidence: "'ListEvaluationJobs' is empty, so no evaluation has ever run — CRITICAL." Bedrock evaluation is region-gated... confirm regional support first and report INFO/advisory, not LLM-EVAL-001

tests.name: Templates and outputs missing
tests.reasoning: Output templates exist in assets/ for both Bedrock and SageMaker paths, and the inline Findings format is specified; the skill's reporting purpose is well served by templates.
tests.evidence: "[evaluation-report-template.md](assets/evaluation-report-template.md) — load when a report is requested on the Bedrock path or the posture review"

tests.name: Templates and outputs must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The inline Findings template is short (a single line format plus bullet explanations), well under 20 lines, with longer templates correctly placed in assets/.

tests.name: Asset files must be linked
tests.reasoning: All three assets files are referenced in the body with markdown links.

tests.name: Asset links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Asset links include explicit load conditions.
tests.evidence: "[delegation-payload.json](assets/delegation-payload.json) is that prompt, finished (load when delegating evidence-gathering)" and "load when a report is requested on the Bedrock path"

tests.name: Asset path format
tests.reasoning: All asset references use relative paths of the form assets/filename with no absolute paths or traversals.

tests.name: Step-by-step guidance
tests.reasoning: The procedural Investigation Procedure section uses the required checkbox 'Step N:' format, and the detailed sections below reference the same step numbers (Step 1, Step 2, etc.).
tests.evidence: "- [ ] Step 1: Understand the question, pick the path and confirm regional support" followed by "### Step 1 — Understand the question, pick the path and confirm regional support"

tests.name: Validation loops
